tossups.question: One explorer from this dynasty was stopped from exploring a Western empire after a Persian sailor told him that “the ocean is huge.” Two elephant-riding leaders who rebelled against this dynasty legendarily drowned themselves in the Hát Giang (“haht zaang”) River to avoid capture. This dynasty dispatched Ma Yuan to crush the rebellion of the Trung sisters. This dynasty’s collapse might have been caused by the Antonine Plague spreading east through the Silk Road earlier established by this dynasty. Towards the end of this dynasty, the Yellow Turban rebellion ushered in the Three Kingdoms period. For 10 points, China’s largest ethnic group is named for what dynasty?
tossups.answer: Han dynasty [accept Western Han or Eastern Han] (The unnamed Western empire in the first line is the Roman Empire.)

tossups.question: When the Dorian mode consists of all white keys on a piano, A has this scale degree. The second voice of a fugue typically enters on this scale degree. For 10 points, the syllable “so” corresponds to what scale degree, exemplified by G in the key of C?

tossups.question: In IR spectroscopy, this property produces bumpy “overtones” between 1600 and 2000 inverse centimeters. tossups.question: A poem addressed to this author describes boys “singing, exposing their waist” “By the East River and the Bronx.” In a poem by this author, the speaker becomes “tired and sick” after being shown “charts and diagrams.” Langston Hughes’s poem “I, Too” serves as a response to a poem by this author that describes the “varied carols” of mechanics, the carpenter and the mason. tossups.question: A woman from this city proved her innocence by towing a ship containing a statue of a foreign goddess off a sandbank. tossups.question: A member of this family established a “Monolithic Ideological System” after he was almost overthrown in the Kapsan faction incident. tossups.question: In two games titled for this activity, Lakitu brings Blooper, a playable “Tricky-type” character, using a fishing rod and a bucket. The music video for a song with this activity in its title features the artist only singing the background lyrics and opens the album Pure Heroine. Patrick Zweig and Art Donaldson enter a love triangle with a character played by Zendaya in a film about this sport, Challengers. tossups.question: Herman Goldstein’s “problem-oriented” approach to this profession inspired the SARA model.
